notes: No duty rota and no animal poison line found for Indonesia (one search; only US/other results; no PDHI or ministry page gives an animal poison number or a duty rota; PDHI pages found were news items only). 24 h clinics are in Bali (Sunset Vet Kuta, BVC Sanur/Pererenan/Tabanan, Kedonganan), Jakarta (Andista Tomang, Sehati x2), Surabaya (Unair RSH, K and P), Yogyakarta, Semarang and Medan. Skipped or not usable: Puskeswan Ragunan / Jakarta provincial hospital (kompas article robots-blocked, no official page found); rshp.unair.ac.id (robots); UGM RSH Prof Soeparwi (rsh.fkh.ugm.ac.id client error, fkh.ugm.ac.id page only faculty contacts +62 274 560862 / 6492088, no hours); Universitas Brawijaya RSHP (bpu.ub.ac.id and fkh.ub.ac.id client errors); dkpp.surabaya.go.id puskeswan and klinikhewan pages (client error); USU Medan and Hasanuddin Makassar vet hospitals (nothing found); PDHB Dr Cucu Sajuthi (pdhbvet.com) and Groovy Vet Care Jakarta (groovyvetcare.com): named as 24 h in a flokq article but own sites not reachable via search/provenance; Bali Central Vet, Vethoscope (Kuta), Vee Vet Denpasar (24/7 claims only in NGO directories); Zenith Animal Care Pekanbaru (TikTok only); De'chruse Batam, Lombok Vet Clinic Mataram (Facebook/Instagram only); LUNI Lombok on the Gili Islands (page gives no contact); JAF Vet (redirect loop); Pawlyclinic Bandung list (addresses only, 22 clinics: Ozora, Gloriavet, Urban Animal Pet Care, Mahapetcare, Vet to Pet, Zoom Vet, UPTD Klinik Hewan Kota Bandung etc.); Bali smaller clinics Canifeli, Saka Vet, Semer Vet, Hadiprata, Anima Vet Care, Nata Pet Care, Virgin Vet Nusa Dua, Joy Vet Care Jimbaran (only directory listings). Still to do: Nusa Dua / Sanur / Ubud own-site clinics, Lombok (Mataram, Senggigi), Medan, Makassar, Batam, Malang and Bandung 24 h clinics, university hospitals (UGM, UB, IPB 24 h?), Jakarta provincial Puskeswan, BSD/Tangerang, Bekasi, Depok.
